changelog:
Clearer meeting transcripts.

A step that fixes misheard names was also rewriting words it shouldn't - "like" became "Luke", "for" became "Fair", "not" became "Note". It now leaves ordinary words alone, while still fixing names you've taught it.

Transcription also switches to an English-only model that hears names better and no longer drops stray foreign characters into English meetings.

Includes 0.1.69: the phone can jump its audio to any transcript line.
